0022600148.text: The 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) visit the Hornets (3-3, 3rd in the Southeast, 8th in the East) in Philadelphia's seventh game of the season. The 76ers are on a two-game winning streak and have gone 5-1 over their last ten, while Charlotte has lost its last two. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, Jaylen Brown, and Tacko Fall, and Charlotte is without Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel, and Kylan Boswell. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the 76ers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 118-114 win in Charlotte on March 28, 2026.
